title_en: At Mangalem Complex 21, Apartment 2+1+2 Newly Invested for Sale!
description_en: At Mangalem Complex 21, Newly Invested 2+1+2 Apartment For Sale. The apartment with a gross area of ​​97.6 m2, net 88 m2 is located on the 3rd floor of a well-managed 9-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room with a separate cooking area, a double bedroom with access to the balcony and a bathroom with a window, a children's room and a main bathroom. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality work, starting from the plumbing and electrical installations, hood system, aluminum double-glazed windows, multisplit air conditioning system, etc. The apartment has furniture and furnishings in the value of 20,000 euros. The property has full mortgage documentation.
